scope: Independent Godot 4.7 Forward+ sea prototype; no game map or game rendering code integration
water_images: None. Water heights, slopes, whitecaps and transported foam are computed.

fft.implementation: Original GPU radix-2 DIT inverse FFT, 128x128, two axes, two cascades
fft.spectrum: Seeded Gaussian Phillips directional spectrum with separate >=6m and 0.65-6m wavelength bands
fft.evolution: Tessendorf Hermitian-paired complex spectral evolution, finite-depth dispersion sqrt(g k tanh(k d))
fft.reference_role: Algorithm and compute architecture reference; its JONSWAP/TMA generator and Stockham FFT implementation are not copied

shallow_water.adaptation: Staggered velocity and upwind height solver inherited from v1; open boundary and deep-water spectral relaxation; shallow water, shore wet/dry cells and solid piers remain interactive

foam: Two transported concentrations plus two transported material coordinates; source from solved compression and choppy-wave Jacobian; no fixed UV foam image
spray: 600 bounded GPU particle slots; proposal distribution follows shore/pier geometry, acceptance samples solved depth and foam impact; projected ballistic flight
runtime: Main RenderingDevice shared textures, fixed 120Hz SWE, one FFT generation per visible update, no CPU readback in interactive use
startup: Prototype GLSL is compiled from source once through RenderingDevice's compiler/cache to avoid stale imported SPIR-V during concurrent editor changes. Standalone export must include the raw .glsl and .glslinc sources.
reuse_art: Previous transparent pier, game floor atlas grass, game shrubs and actual v03 game player; no new water or foam art
limitations: Heightfield cannot simulate overturning 3D wave geometry
Spectral and SWE coupling is an artistic open-ocean relaxation, not a mass-conserving closed-domain coupling
Bathymetry and pier obstacle placement are prototype approximations
Whole-map and mobile performance have not been measured
